_comment: Documents the intended multi-region setup; provisioning three
separate Vercel projects (one per region) is done by ops in the
Vercel dashboard/CLI, not by this file alone. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
Kenya (primary):    Vercel project 'hurbad-ecommerce-ke', region lhr1 (eu-west-2, London)
Ethiopia (Phase 2): Vercel project 'hurbad-ecommerce-et', region cpt1 (af-south-1, Cape Town)
Somalia (Phase 2):  Vercel project 'hurbad-ecommerce-so', region lhr1 (eu-west-2, London)
Each project gets its own env vars (DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_READ_REPLICA_URL,
NEXT_PUBLIC_REGION, payment gateway keys, currency, tax rate) set via
`vercel env add` or the dashboard — see .env.production.{kenya,ethiopia,somalia}
for the full variable list per region.
